# Errors

```ts
const duplicate = await User.create({ email: 'new@example.com' }).catch(
  (error: unknown) => error,
);
const invalid = await User.create({ email: null as unknown as string }).catch(
  (error: unknown) => error,
);
const bad = await sequelize
  .query('SELECT * FROM "no_such_table"')
  .catch((error: unknown) => error);
// UniqueConstraintError and ValidationError extend ValidationError/BaseError; DatabaseError wraps
// any other server error: `error.parent` holds the pg error with `code`, `detail`, `constraint`
```

| Class | When |
| --- | --- |
| `ValidationError` (`.errors[]`) | validators, `allowNull`, schema validation |
| `UniqueConstraintError`, `ForeignKeyConstraintError`, `ExclusionConstraintError` | constraint violation |
| `DatabaseError` (`.parent` holds the `pg` error with `code`, `detail`, `constraint`) | any other server error |
| `TimeoutError` | cancelled statement (SQLSTATE 57014) |
| `OptimisticLockError` | stale `version` on save |
| `EmptyResultError` | `rejectOnEmpty` found nothing |
| `ConnectionError` and subclasses | cannot connect or authenticate |

```ts
const error = await Signup.create({ email: 'nope', age: 12, role: 'admin' }).catch(
  (caught: unknown) => caught,
);
if (error instanceof ValidationError) {
  const paths = error.errors.map((item) => `${String(item.path)}:${String(item.validatorKey)}`);
  // paths: ['email:schema', 'role:schema']
  audit.push(...paths.toSorted());
}
```
